findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "requests_submit" is 2998 chars, far longer than this server's median (520). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: how_ridekick_works, requests_list, requests_get, requests_submit, get_offer_sheet, messages_preview, messages_list, visit_times · Private data: requests_preview, requests_submit, archive_request, requests_stop_dealership · Public sink: how_ridekick_works, requests_list, requests_get, requests_submit, access_get, messages_preview, messages_send, messages_list, book_visit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: how_ridekick_works, requests_list, requests_get, requests_submit, get_offer_sheet, messages_preview, messages_list, visit_times · Private data: requests_preview, requests_submit, archive_request, requests_stop_dealership · Public sink: how_ridekick_works, requests_list, requests_get, requests_submit, access_get, messages_preview, messages_send, messages_list, book_visit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
